usedFor: Shopify generates the product news; Postify plans and publishes it to social channels. A “New Product” in Shopify can run “Create Post” so a listing becomes a post.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Post” in Postify
bestTemplate.why: A new product turns into a draft, scheduled or live post for the channels you choose, which is the most direct way to announce it.

watchOut: “Reschedule Post” moves an existing post, so it needs one already created and cannot start a post from a Shopify event. “Abandoned Checkout” is polling.
